risk_summary: The disclosure is generally quantified and transparent regarding market conditions, revenue sources, reserves, and liquidity, but relies on standard forward-looking disclaimers and management estimates. Key risks include elevated mortgage rates, real-estate volatility, long-tail title claims, reserve uncertainty, and dependence on projected market recovery. Management expresses moderate confidence in funding sufficiency and reserve adequacy despite these uncertainties.
